release_decision: All skipped-test categories from the historical Windows aggregate pytest run were closed by rerunning them on required substrates or with required dependencies. The native GStreamer caption-SEI proof passed with the CivicCast-bundled private GStreamer runtime containing tttocea608, ccconverter, cccombiner, and h264ccinserter. The scoped public beta gate may claim native caption-SEI embedding only when that bundled runtime is extracted and verified; stock Ubuntu 24.04 GStreamer packages alone remain insufficient.
